$comment: The values of this repository for the shared release tool (scripts/ci/release*.mjs, resolve-milestone.mjs, check-release-plan.mjs), whose files are the same in every Kuestenlogik repository that carries it. Every key is required; release-plan.mjs validateConfig says what each holds. The board has no Release field: a ticket's milestone is its plan.
afterCut: post-release-floor-bump.yml raises <Version> in Directory.Build.props (still {current}) once the release pipeline has passed; plan the next release: every ticket names its milestone.
